shortDescription: Bausch + Lomb is an eye health company providing vision care products, contact lenses, pharmaceuticals, and ophthalmic surgical technologies.
whatTheyDo: Through its regional commercial entity, Bausch Health Trading DWC, the company coordinates the sales, marketing, distribution, and regulatory affairs for ophthalmic pharmaceuticals, contact lenses, and surgical equipment across the Middle East. It serves ophthalmologists, optometrists, hospitals, clinics, and optical retail networks throughout the region.
address: 14th Floor, Rolex Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Dubai Chamber of Commerce & Industry Commercial Directory

notes: Input listed Downtown; the registered regional operating entity is Bausch Health Trading DWC, located at Rolex Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road near Downtown/DIFC.

shortDescription: Bayer Middle East FZE serves as the regional headquarters for Bayer's pharmaceuticals, consumer health, and crop science operations.
whatTheyDo: The regional headquarters oversees commercial operations, regulatory affairs, clinical research support, and distribution across the Middle East. Based in an activity-based working environment at Dubai Science Park, the company supports healthcare professionals, patients, and agricultural producers with medicines, health products, and agronomic solutions.
address: Dubai Science Park Towers (North Tower), 13th Floor, Al Barsha South 2, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Dubai Media Office - Bayer Regional Headquarters at Dubai Science Park

notes: Input listed Business Bay; Bayer Middle East FZE is officially headquartered at Dubai Science Park Towers (North Tower, 13th Floor) in Al Barsha South 2, Dubai.

shortDescription: Bayut is a UAE-based real estate and property classifieds portal operating under Dubizzle Group.
whatTheyDo: Bayut operates an online property marketplace providing classifieds and search tools for buying, selling, and renting properties across the UAE. Operating under Dubizzle Group, its in-house engineering and data teams build PropTech solutions, market analytics, and interactive transaction indices in collaboration with the Dubai Land Department. The platform serves home seekers, real estate agencies, and property developers.
address: Floor 7, Building 3, Dubai Design District (d3), Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Dubai Internet City; the registered corporate headquarters of Bayut Web Publishing FZ-LLC is located at Building 3, Dubai Design District (d3).

shortDescription: BDP Global Project Logistics LLC (PSA BDP) provides end-to-end supply chain management, freight forwarding, and project logistics services.
whatTheyDo: Operating as the Middle East, Türkiye, and Africa headquarters for PSA BDP, the company manages ocean and air freight, multimodal transportation, customs clearance, and heavy-lift project cargo. It supports major industrial projects in sectors such as energy, oil and gas, and infrastructure with route surveys and specialized logistics coordination. Operations run from commercial offices in central Dubai as well as cargo facilities at Dubai Logistics City and Cargo Village.
commonCareers: Warehouse and Overland Transportation Team Leader
address: Burj Al Salam Office Building, Office 1602-1606, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Dubai Internet City; the regional headquarters of BDP Global Project Logistics LLC is located at Burj Al Salam Office Building on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai.

shortDescription: Beiersdorf Middle East is the regional commercial entity managing international skincare brands including NIVEA and Eucerin.
whatTheyDo: Beiersdorf Middle East FZCO serves as the regional hub for sales, brand management, digital marketing, supply chain, and retail distribution across the MENA region. The team manages commercial strategies and trade partnerships for global personal care brands including NIVEA, Eucerin, and Hansaplast. Its operations coordinate with major retail chains, e-commerce partners, and pharmacy distributors.
address: Zee Tower, 1st Floor, Abdullah Omran Taryam Street, Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh 2, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Belhasa International Company LLC is a major Emirati conglomerate with operations across automotive, construction, real estate, and education.
whatTheyDo: Belhasa International Company LLC oversees more than thirty subsidiary companies across the UAE, including Emirates Driving Institute, Belhasa Projects, and Belhasa Real Estate. Its businesses cover civil construction, swimming pools and landscaping, driving education, transport, facilities management, and hospitality. The group provides commercial and public services to government bodies, corporations, and consumers nationwide.

shortDescription: Binghatti Holding is an Emirati real estate development and asset management group based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Binghatti Holding develops architectural residential and commercial properties, including branded luxury towers in partnership with brands such as Bugatti, Jacob & Co, and Mercedes-Benz. Its corporate group encompasses real estate development, architecture, engineering, hospitality, and an asset management arm regulated by the DFSA in DIFC. It serves individual property buyers, luxury real estate investors, and institutional capital.
address: Suite 108, Level 1, Gate Village 6, Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Dubai International Financial Centre Public Records and Announcements

notes: Input listed JLT; corporate holding entity (Binghatti Holding Limited) is registered and headquartered in Gate Village 6, DIFC, Dubai.

shortDescription: BNC Network is a digital construction intelligence and project tracking platform operated by Industry Networks FZC.
whatTheyDo: BNC Network operates a cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform tracking construction, infrastructure, and oil & gas projects across the Middle East and Africa. Its platform aggregates data on tenders, contractors, consultants, and project statuses to provide market intelligence and sales automation tools to businesses in the construction supply chain. Research analysts track projects through direct relationships with developers and public authorities.
address: Industry Network FZC, G1-3, 61st Street, SAIF Zone, Sharjah, UAE
notes: Input listed Dubai, Dubai Internet City; BNC Network is the project intelligence platform operated by Industry Networks FZC, which is headquartered in SAIF Zone, Sharjah. Coordinates omitted as only zone/street was verified.

shortDescription: Bon Education is a UAE-based education consulting and learning design agency.
whatTheyDo: Bon Education develops custom learning programs, workforce readiness initiatives, and educational consulting solutions across the UAE. As a primary delivery partner for the Dubai Business Associates (DBA) programme run under the patronage of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, it facilitates executive training, career coaching, and cultural integration modules. It partners with government agencies, multinational corporations, and non-profits on talent development initiatives.
address: Ras Al Khaimah and Abu Dhabi, UAE
notes: Input listed Dubai, Downtown; Bon Education lists UAE offices in Ras Al Khaimah and Abu Dhabi while running key programs in Dubai (including Dubai Business Associates). Standalone street coordinates in Dubai could not be confirmed, so coordinates are null.

shortDescription: Booz Allen Hamilton provides defense, intelligence, and cybersecurity consulting services.
whatTheyDo: Booz Allen Hamilton historically delivered management and digital consulting across the Middle East. Following the September 2022 acquisition of its MENA commercial management consulting and cybersecurity practices by Oliver Wyman, Booz Allen Hamilton retained operations focusing on U.S. government, defense, and national security clients in the region. Its technical work focuses on defense technology systems, cybersecurity advisory, and intelligence support.
address: Gate Precinct Building 3, Units 405 & 406, Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Consultancy-me - Oliver Wyman Acquires Booz Allen MENA Practice

notes: Input listed Business Bay; Booz Allen Hamilton operated in Dubai from Gate Precinct Building 3, DIFC. In September 2022, Booz Allen Hamilton sold its Middle East and North Africa (MENA) commercial management consulting business to Oliver Wyman, maintaining regional presence primarily for U.S. government and defense client engagements.
